verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no in-product feature that analyzes a user's data, such as call logs or transcripts, and returns AI-generated insights or suggestions. Composer builds assistants from a description, and Evals and Voice Test Suites run validation tests. Neither is data-driven insight generation, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
